en: Black‑and‑white image showing a small group of adults and children wearing late‑19th/early‑20th‑century European clothing, gathered near a weir or small dam on a river or canal. In the foreground is flowing water over a low stone spillway with a simple sluice gate. Beyond the water is an open grassy slope leading up to an old stone building complex that looks like a partially ruined medieval castle or fortified manor with a tall tower and steep, gabled roof. Trees frame the scene at the sides. At the very bottom edge, faint handwritten white text appears, partially cut off.
